https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/analyse-req.description: POST /v1/ai/analyse. Text is transient: the AI service must not store or log it.

context.description: Up to 10 earlier redacted messages, oldest first.

onDevice.description: The phone's own verdict. Returned unchanged (verdictSource on_device) when no cloud model judges the message.

text.description: Already redacted on the phone: names, phone numbers, emails and handles replaced with [CONTACT_n], [PHONE_n], [EMAIL_n], [HANDLE_n].

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/analyse-req.title: AnalyseRequest

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/approval-re.description: The child's phone asks the parent to approve a share or deletion (from casefile.share.requested).
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/approval-re.title: ApprovalRequest

childId.description: The child the request came from, so the parent's phone signs with that child's family key.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/bundle-requ.description: Asks for an upload slot for an encrypted evidence bundle.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/bundle-requ.title: BundleRequest

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/evidence-re.description: POST /v1/guardian/children/{childId}/evidence. The parent asks to see a case's messages; the child decides. Signed with the family key over evidence|requestId|caseId.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/evidence-re.title: EvidenceRequest

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/feedback-re.description: Sent only when the child consented to training (consentToTrain).
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/feedback-re.title: FeedbackRequest

missingPermissions.description: Permissions Nilinde needs that are currently off.

protectionActive.description: False when the accessibility/notification service is off.

decisions.description: Parent decisions on this child's approval requests not yet delivered.

evidenceRequests.description: Parent requests to see a case's messages, not yet delivered.

policy.description: Present when a newer policy than the phone's exists.

reports.description: Parent report requests for this child not yet delivered.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/pairing-cod.description: The parent starts adding a child with the first, signed policy.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/pairing-cod.title: PairingCodeRequest

devicePublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the device's ECDSA P-256 key.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/parent-regi.description: Creates a parent account tied to a random ID. No name, phone number or email.

devicePublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the parent phone's key (device binding).

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/parent-regi.title: ParentRegistrationRequest

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/report-requ.description: POST /v1/guardian/children/{childId}/reports. The parent reports a case. Signed with the family key over reportId|caseId|recipientType|anonymous.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/report-requ.title: ReportRequest

sealedLink.description: The share link (its key is in the #fragment), sealed with the family key. Only the parent's phone can open it.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/share-downl.description: Where a recipient downloads a shared, encrypted case bundle. The decryption key is never sent to the server: it travels in the share link's #fragment.

bundleHash.description: SHA-256 of the encrypted bundle, so the recipient can check the download.

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived URL of the encrypted bundle.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/share-downl.title: ShareDownload

bundleId.description: The uploaded, encrypted bundle to share. Defaults to the case's latest uploaded bundle.

signature.description: Base64 signature by the timestamp authority over hash|timestamp.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/translate-r.description: POST /v1/ai/translate. Text is transient: the AI service must not store or log it.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/translate-r.title: TranslateRequest

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/translate-r.description: POST /v1/ai/translate response. Machine translations are labelled as such wherever they are shown; the original stays the evidence.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/api/translate-r.title: TranslateResponse

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: A case crossed an escalation rule.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileCaseEscalated

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: A case gained an incident or changed severity.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileCaseUpdated

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: PHONE ONLY. The child answered a parent's request to see a case's messages. Guardian seals the bundle for the parent.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileEvidenceReady

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: An evidence item was hashed into the vault's chain.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileEvidenceSealed

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: PHONE ONLY. Casefile built a parent's report. The link carries the decryption key in its #fragment.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileReportReady

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: A share link was issued to the recipient.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileShareCompleted

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.description: The child asked to share a case; needs parent approval.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/casefile.title: CasefileShareRequested

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/companio.description: Companion showed a piece of advice.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/companio.title: CompanionAdviceShown

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/companio.description: The child asked to capture the current conversation.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/companio.title: CompanionCaptureRequested

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/companio.description: The child said whether a flag was right.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/companio.title: CompanionFeedbackSubmitted

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/envelope.description: Wraps every event. No envelope field ever holds a real name, phone number or message text.

caseId.description: Pseudonymous, random. Absent before a case exists.

deviceId.description: Random per-install ID. Not a hardware ID.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/envelope.title: Envelope

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.description: PHONE ONLY. The parent asked to see a case's messages; the family-key signature has been checked. Casefile asks the child.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.title: GuardianEvidenceRequested

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.description: A child device was paired with a parent.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.title: GuardianPairingCompleted

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.description: A parent changed the child's policy.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.title: GuardianPolicyUpdated

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.description: PHONE ONLY. The parent asked for a case to be reported; the family-key signature has been checked. childNames never leave the phone.

childNames.description: Names to withhold in an anonymous report.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.title: GuardianReportRequested

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.description: A parent approved a share request.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.title: GuardianShareApproved

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.description: A parent declined a share request.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/guardian.title: GuardianShareDeclined

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.description: PHONE ONLY. Sentinel captured the conversation around a flag, with real text.

screenshotRef.description: Local file reference inside sentinel storage.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.title: SentinelCaptureReady

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.description: PHONE ONLY. The child is in a watched conversation now (drives the keyboard companion).
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.title: SentinelConversationActive

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.description: Sentinel revised a flag, e.g. after more context or a cloud analysis.

dismissed.description: True when a later verdict (cloud analysis or the child's feedback) found the message not harmful. Absent means false. severity and category then repeat the original flag.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.title: SentinelFlagUpdated

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.description: Sentinel flagged an incoming message as harmful.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/events/sentinel.title: SentinelMessageFlagged

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/advice-ke.description: A key into kuuma-lang advice-keys.yaml, e.g. advice.threat.tell_adult. Advice text never travels in an event.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/advice-ke.title: AdviceKey

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/age-brack.description: Age group of the child: 12 and under, 13 to 15, 16 to 18. Decides alert thresholds, advice depth and which screens the child sees.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/age-brack.title: AgeBracket

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/alert-kin.description: What raised an alert. tamper: Nilinde's permissions were turned off or the phone stopped checking in.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/alert-kin.title: AlertKind

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/alert.jso.description: An alert shown to a parent. Holds no message content.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/alert.jso.title: Alert

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/api-error.description: Details of a failed API call.

message.description: Developer-facing message. Never contains user content.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/api-error.title: ApiError

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/app-sourc.description: The messaging app a message arrived through.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/app-sourc.title: AppSource

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/approval-.description: A parent's decision on a share request.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/approval-.title: ApprovalDecision

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/approval-.description: What a parent is asked to approve.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/approval-.title: ApprovalKind

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/artifact-.description: A downloadable, hash-checked artifact: a model, a lexicon or a content pack.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/artifact-.title: ArtifactManifest

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/captured-.description: PHONE ONLY. One message of a captured conversation, with real text. Only allowed inside phone-only events.

senderDisplayName.description: As shown in the source app. Phone only.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/captured-.title: CapturedMessage

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/error-res.description: The body of every non-2xx API response.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/error-res.title: ErrorResponse

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.description: PHONE ONLY (travels sealed). The messages of one case as the child's phone holds them, with who sent them. Never sent to a service in the clear.

senderNames.description: Names the sender appeared under in the messaging app.

senderNumbers.description: Phone numbers the sender used or wrote.

truncated.description: Older messages were left out to fit.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.title: EvidenceBundle

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.description: One message in an EvidenceBundle (phone only, travels sealed).

sender.description: As the messaging app showed them; absent for the child's own messages.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.title: EvidenceMessage

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.description: A parent's request to see a case's messages, delivered to the child's phone at its heartbeat. The phone asks the child only if the family-key signature verifies.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.title: EvidenceOrder

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.description: What the child decided about a parent's request to see a case's messages.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.title: EvidenceOutcome

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.description: A parent's request to see a case's messages. requested: waiting for the child. ready: the child allowed it and the messages are sealed for the parent. declined: the child said no. failed: the phone could not build it.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/evidence-.title: EvidenceStatus

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/family-si.description: base64url HMAC-SHA256 by the parent's phone with the family key. The family key travels only in the pairing QR code, so the server can neither read nor forge what it signs.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/family-si.title: FamilySignature

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/feedback-.description: The child's verdict on a flag.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/feedback-.title: FeedbackVerdict

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/grooming-.description: Stages of a grooming pattern, in the order they usually appear.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/grooming-.title: GroomingStage

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/harm-cate.description: The kind of harm a message carries.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/harm-cate.title: HarmCategory

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/interpret.description: Plain-English meaning of a redacted, possibly code-switched message, from the language model. Transient: never stored or logged.

promptVersion.description: Prompt id and version, e.g. interpret@1.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/interpret.title: Interpretation

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/language..description: Supported languages: English, Luganda, Runyankole, Swahili.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/language..title: Language

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/link-sugg.description: A suggestion that two sender refs are probably the same offender.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/link-sugg.title: LinkSuggestion

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/offender-.description: A pseudonymous label for an offender inside one case, e.g. 'Person A'. Never a real name or handle.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/offender-.title: OffenderLabel

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/opaque-re.description: A salted hash standing in for a message, conversation or sender: 'or1_' + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(deviceSalt, value)), unpadded. Not reversible off the phone.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/opaque-re.title: OpaqueRef

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/permissio.description: An Android permission or special access name.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/permissio.title: PermissionName

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/policy.js.description: The monitoring policy a parent sets for one child.

signature.description: Parent's signature over ageBracket|watchedApps(sorted, comma)|flagMinConfidence(3 dp)|alertMinSeverity|captureMinSeverity|policyVersion. The child's phone rejects a policy without a valid one.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/policy.js.title: Policy

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/recipient.description: Who a case can be shared with.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/recipient.title: RecipientType

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/reply-ris.description: What the reply-risk checker found in a draft the child is typing.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/reply-ris.title: ReplyRisk

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/report-or.description: A parent's report request, delivered to the child's phone at its heartbeat. The phone builds the case file only if the family-key signature verifies.

anonymous.description: Leave out everything that could identify the child.

sealedChildName.description: The child's name as the parent knows it, sealed with the family key, so the phone can withhold messages that name the child. The server cannot read it.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/report-or.title: ReportOrder

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/report-ou.description: What the child's phone did with a parent's report request.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/report-ou.title: ReportOutcome

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/report-st.description: A parent's report of a case. requested: waiting for the child's phone to build it. ready: the share link exists (sealed for the parent). failed: the phone could not build it.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/report-st.title: ReportStatus

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/risky-spa.description: A risky part of a draft reply, as character offsets [start, end).
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/risky-spa.title: RiskySpan

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/sealed-ev.description: base64url of AES-256-GCM(familyKey, 12-byte IV || ciphertext) of an EvidenceBundle as JSON. Only the parent's phone can open it; the server stores ciphertext only.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/sealed-ev.title: SealedEvidence

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/sealed-ex.description: base64url of AES-256-GCM(familyKey, 12-byte IV || ciphertext) of the offending message. Only the parent's phone can open it; the server stores ciphertext only.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/sealed-ex.title: SealedExcerpt

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/severity..description: How serious a harmful message is.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/severity..title: Severity

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/sha256.js.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/sha256.js.title: Sha256

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/threshold.description: PLACEHOLDER detection and alert thresholds until the team agrees values.

alertMinSeverity.description: Minimum case severity before Guardian alerts the parent.

captureMinSeverity.description: Minimum flag severity before evidence is captured automatically.

flagMinConfidence.description: Minimum classifier confidence for Sentinel to raise a flag.

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/threshold.title: Thresholds

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/timestamp.description: An instant in UTC: ISO-8601 with a literal Z, e.g. 2026-11-05T09:30:00Z.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/timestamp.title: Timestamp

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/uuid.json.description: A random (v4) UUID in lowercase canonical form.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/uuid.json.title: Uuid

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/verdict-s.description: Who produced an analyse verdict. on_device: the phone's classifier verdict, passed back unchanged (the cloud added only an interpretation). reasoning_model: the cloud reasoning model.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/verdict-s.title: VerdictSource

https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/verdict.j.description: What a harm classifier decided about one message. category and severity are absent when harmful is false.
https://schemas.kuuma.ug/types/verdict.j.title: Verdict
